verdict.rationale: LM Studio's core value proposition is fully local, offline LLM inference and RAG (docs-1, docs-7), meaning user data and chats never leave the device and thus can't be harvested for training by default. However, there is no explicit privacy policy or data-training statement in the evidence, and community notes flag the app (including the new Bionic agent) as closed-source, leaving no independent verification of what telemetry or cloud features (e.g., model downloads, MCP connections) might transmit.
